experience.title: Senior Backend Engineer
evidence: - Lead a team of four engineers responsible for tenant provisioning, billing events, and internal developer APIs for a multi-tenant SaaS platform.
- Designed and operated Go services using PostgreSQL, Kafka, Redis, Docker, and Kubernetes. Reduced duplicate billing events by adding idempotency controls and a reconciliation workflow.
- Participated in a paid, follow-the-sun on-call rotation. Wrote runbooks, dashboards, and alerts using Prometheus and Grafana.
- Worked with product and support teams on enterprise customer escalations.

experience.title: Software Engineer
evidence: - Built REST and gRPC APIs in Go for a logistics planning product used by customers in Germany, France, and the Netherlands.
- Migrated scheduled imports from a monolith to event-driven workers and improved delivery monitoring.
- Maintained Terraform modules and AWS infrastructure with the platform team.
